answer.rationale: The 18% cost reduction mandate is non-negotiable and the low-cost vendor's quote alone satisfies it. Historical evidence (memory_c2) confirms that switching to this vendor previously delivered sharp unit-cost cuts with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, indicating acceptable delivery performance. Incumbent renewal (memory_c1) guarantees stability but cannot be assumed to meet the 18% target, and renegotiation (memory_c4) is time-constrained (14 days) with no guarantee of achieving the mandate. With the assembly line at 94% capacity and no buffer, deferring or experimenting risks supply disruption; a full switch to the proven low-cost vendor is the most direct path to satisfy the financial objective without materially increasing delivery risk beyond the verified historical performance.
